caption_L1: Here a is a bar diagram named Number of married people in Canada in 2020 , by age group. The y-axis shows Number of people while the x-axis shows Age group.
caption_L2L3: The age group with the most number of people married in Canada in 2020 was 55-59 year olds. Either side of this age group, the numbers decrease. The age groups with the lowest number of people married were 100 years and over, 15-19 year olds, 20-24 year olds, 85 to 89 year olds, 90 to 94 year old and 95 to 99 year olds. From this visualisation it can be seen that most people who are married are between 30-79 years old.
